page.layout: One printed page, cut at the right edge. Heading "ERRATA" across the top. Below both, a full-width NOTA paragraph, also cut at the right edge.; One page of text in two columns of list entries at the top-left, with a continuation line at the right; below them a faint scatter of stains and a few printed lines at the right; no running head or page number visible.

page.notes: The right-hand column of the errata is cut off at the scan edge, so its numbers are only partly visible. The lines marked as numbers alone are fragments. Some digits in the left column (e.g. "359", "360") are uncertain. The NOTA line is cut off at the right edge. Right-hand fragment of a table of contents: the page is cut and the left halves of the lines are missing; faint marks and stains are not transcribed. Doubtful letters in the list are copied as they appear. The word "Occul-" is a partly visible catchword-like fragment at the right, written as a line.
